# Bundled third-party libraries (AppImage)

M6-14 notices, with M6-10. The library list is derived from the built artifact itself: `babel_0.0.1_amd64.AppImage` extracted with `--appimage-extract`, every ELF binary, provider module and font inventoried, each mapped to the Arch package that provided it. The machine-readable record is [package-inventory.json](package-inventory.json); the file the package ships is [NOTICES.md](NOTICES.md) (`usr/lib/babel/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` in the package).

Inventoried artifact AppImage SHA-256: `38710fb1cba4622bc0b744ed8891a2d23f3e6045322279cac3feaa30759a805e`.

Scope: Every ELF binary, provider module and font in the AppDir is attributed in entries or trees. Own movables (icons, .desktop) need no third-party notice. Compiled Rust-crate and transitive npm texts remain M6-10 work (limitations L2/L3); direct JS runtime texts are retained.

## Limitations

- L1: Arch binary packages that ship no licence file use the canonical SPDX text from the installed licenses package; the upstream COPYING was verified locally only for Enchant, Hunspell and libltdl.
- L2: Transitive Rust-crate licence texts compiled into usr/bin/babel-desktop are not yet retained; only the statically linked libgit2 and the git2 binding licences are (M6-10 remainder).
- L3: Transitive npm module texts bundled into the frontend are not yet retained; direct runtime dependencies are (M6-10 remainder).

Dictionaries (SCOWL/`hunspell-en_us`) stay a host prerequisite per [ADR 0045](../decisions/0045-user-install-and-packaged-spelling.md): bundling one language would add dictionary licence texts for partial coverage while every other language still came from the host. This task builds the notice file and the CI gate, so bundling a dictionary later is mechanically unblocked; the decision is recorded in [ADR 0046](../decisions/0046-package-notice-file.md).

## Native closure (dynamically linked, bundled by linuxdeploy)

Each row is one Arch package that provided bundled files. Version, declared licence and upstream URL are the installed-package metadata as resolved on the build host; per-file SHA-256 is in `package-inventory.json`. `-only` and `-or-later` variants share one licence document; the difference lives in the project's copyright notice, not the text.

## Host prerequisites versus redistribution obligations

Everything above is redistributed inside the AppImage and therefore carries a retained notice. The following is loaded from the host at runtime or required around the package; it is a declared host prerequisite, not a redistribution obligation:

- `/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2` resolves to `/usr/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2` (needed by WebKitNetworkProcess, WebKitWebProcess, babel-desktop). Loaded from the host; not bundled, not redistributed.
